title: Case: Return label will not scan at the drop-off shop
context: An email about a return label arrived from an address that is not linked to any order in the desk's file. The Return label team reissued a label for a different-looking name earlier the same morning.
initial_request: hi, the returns label you sent me wont scan at the drop off shop. the man tried it 3 times and said the barcode is dead. can you send a new one today pls, i need it gone before i go away friday. its the big box not the small one. thanks Fenella

events.body: Hi, any update on DL-74191? It was meant to come Friday. Thanks.

Thanks,
Perpetua
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

Label reissue done for DL-6470 / TG-2754 (returner J. Pellow, cast-iron skillet set). New label emailed to the address on the order at 08:32, old label is void. Reminder: we reissue against the DL or TG reference only. We cannot search by name or by email address.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask for the DL shipment reference or TG order number of the return whose label will not scan.

must: Asks Fenella Whitlock for the DL shipment reference or TG order number of the return
Sends the request to Fenella Whitlock, not to the Return label team
Makes no claim that a replacement label has been or will be issued today
must_not: Asks the Return label team to reissue or resend a label for DL-6470 / TG-2754 on the assumption that J. Pellow is Fenella Whitlock
Tells Fenella Whitlock that a new label was already emailed this morning, or shares any detail of DL-6470 / TG-2754
Asks for card details, a full home address, date of birth or other identity data beyond the order or shipment reference
Promises a new label today or before Friday
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Hello Fenella, sorry the label would not scan. So that the label team can find your return, please send me the shipment reference (DL- followed by three digits) or the order number (TG- followed by three digits). Either is on your order confirmation email and on the label itself. That is all I need for now. Once I have it I will ask the label team for a replacement; I cannot yet say when it will be issued.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-301: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 3 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
